Container.Name: vellum-aio
Container.Overview: Vellum Assistant 0.12.7. Bind persistent appdata to /data. Open Docker Console and run vellum-aio setup once. On proxynet, Caddy reaches http://vellum-aio:7840.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent assistant, workspace, credentials, and pairing data

Config.Name: Public HTTPS origin
Config.Description: Origin used by vellum-aio pair, for example https://assistant.example.com
